responsibility: Core C support library for GNAT OS and runtime interfacing. This file implements the large body of imported low-level services declared in adaint.h and referenced from packages such as GNAT.OS_Lib and Osint: file and path operations, process and spawn/wait support, timestamps and attributes, CPU and thread helpers, executable discovery, canonical path conversion, Windows codepage state, and many target-specific portability shims. It is the main implementation unit for cross-platform system calls used by both the Ada compiler tools and the GNAT runtime.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation unit in the adaint pair: it provides the bodies of the broad __gnat_* OS-interface services and hosts the platform-specific syscall glue, such as CPU-set helpers, process killing, executable load-address discovery, and many other low-level operations. Unlike gcc/ada/adaint.h, it performs the cross-platform runtime/compiler support work instead of defining the shared types, macros, globals, and prototypes.
